# Copilot Instructions — Syed Ali personal portfolio

You are writing a **static, single-page personal portfolio** for Syed Ali, a full-stack
developer in Quetta, Pakistan who sells website fixes to Australian small businesses.

Read this file before every suggestion. It is the spec; do not invent outside it.

---

## Hard constraints

- **Vanilla only.** HTML + CSS + ES modules. No React, no Vue, no Tailwind, no jQuery,
  no build step, no bundler. The site must run by opening `index.html` or `npx serve`.
- **No backend.** No Node server, no Express, no database, no API routes.
  Contact form posts to Formspree (`https://formspree.io/f/XXXXXXX`) via `fetch`.
- **No frameworks for animation.** The hero scrubber is plain `requestAnimationFrame` + `<canvas>`.
- **Never use `<video>` with `currentTime` for the scroll effect.** Frame sequences on canvas only.
- No lorem ipsum. No placeholder copy like "Lorem" or "Your Company".
- No stock photos of offices, handshakes, or people at laptops. Use real screenshots only.
- No emoji in the UI. No gradient-mesh orbs. No "Unlock the power of…" copy.

---

## File structure (create exactly this)

```
/
├── index.html
├── assets/
│   ├── styles.css
│   ├── main.js
│   ├── frames/
│   │   ├── desktop/f_0001.webp … f_0120.webp
│   │   ├── mobile/f_0001.webp … f_0060.webp
│   │   └── manifest.json
│   └── shots/            (project screenshots — provided, do not generate)
└── README.md
```

`assets/frames/manifest.json` is generated by `tools/extract-frames.py`. Shape:

```json
{
  "desktop": { "count": 120, "width": 1600, "height": 900, "path": "assets/frames/desktop/f_{n:04d}.webp" },
  "mobile":  { "count": 60,  "width": 720,  "height": 405, "path": "assets/frames/mobile/f_{n:04d}.webp" },
  "poster":  "assets/frames/desktop/f_0001.webp"
}
```

Read the manifest at runtime. **Never hardcode the frame count.**

## Design tokens

```css
:root {
  --ink:      #08090A;   /* page background */
  --bone:     #F2EFE9;   /* primary text */
  --muted:    #8A8A85;   /* secondary text */
  --line:     #1E1F21;   /* hairline borders */
  --accent:   #C8F04B;   /* single accent — used sparingly, max 3 places */

  --font-sans: "Inter", system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
  --font-mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, monospace;

  --step-0: clamp(1rem, 0.95rem + 0.25vw, 1.125rem);
  --step-1: clamp(1.25rem, 1.1rem + 0.75vw, 1.75rem);
  --step-2: clamp(2rem, 1.4rem + 3vw, 4rem);
  --step-3: clamp(2.75rem, 1.6rem + 5.5vw, 7rem);
}
```

Typography: sans for body, **mono for labels, eyebrows, numbers, and the offer price**.
Type is large — the hero heading uses `--step-3` and is allowed to wrap awkwardly-close.
Sentence case everywhere. No Title Case In Headings. No ALL CAPS except 12px mono labels.

Layout: max-width `1120px`, generous vertical rhythm (`--space: clamp(6rem, 12vh, 11rem)`
between sections). Left-aligned, never centred body text.

---

## Section order

1. **Hero** — full-viewport scroll-scrubbed canvas + name + one-line positioning.
2. **Proof** — 3 short stats as mono numerals (e.g. `2 shipped apps`, `MERN`, `48h turnaround`).
3. **Work** — two real case studies: **Easy-Parking** and **LapToPia**. Each: screenshot,
   one-line problem, what was built, stack, measurable outcome. No invented metrics.
4. **Offer** — "Website Fix — $149 AUD" with exactly what is included and the turnaround.
   Price in mono, large. Single CTA.
5. **About** — 3 short paragraphs max. Real, first-person, no buzzwords.
6. **Contact** — email link `hello@syedalihax.com` + Formspree form (name, email, site URL, message).
7. **Footer** — copyright, small print.

---

## Hero scrubber — the core technical requirement

Implementation must satisfy all of these:

1. A tall scroll container (`height: 400vh`) wraps a `position: sticky; top: 0` stage.
2. Progress = `scrollY / (containerHeight - viewportHeight)`, clamped 0–1.
3. Frame index = `Math.round(progress * (count - 1))`.
4. Draw the frame to a `<canvas>` sized to the viewport with `devicePixelRatio` scaling.
   Use `ctx.drawImage`, cover-fit (crop, never stretch).
5. **Preload strategy:** load frames 1–20 immediately, then the rest in the background
   with a small concurrency queue (max 6 in flight). Show a thin progress bar until
   frame 20 is decoded, then fade it out. Never block the first paint on all frames.
6. **Scroll handling:** update a `targetProgress` on scroll, and in a `requestAnimationFrame`
   loop lerp the current value toward it (`current += (target - current) * 0.12`) so the
   scrub feels weighted, not twitchy. Stop the rAF loop when the delta is < 0.001.
7. **Never call drawImage more than once per animation frame.** Guard with a `lastDrawn` index;
   if the index hasn't changed, skip the draw.
8. **Reduced motion:** if `matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches`,
   skip the whole scrubber and show the poster frame as a static image.
9. **Mobile:** viewport width `< 820px` loads the mobile frame set (60 frames) and reduces the
   scroll container to `300vh`.
10. **Fallback:** if the manifest fails to load, render the CSS gradient background and section
    text — the page must remain fully readable.

---

## Performance budget (non-negotiable)

| Metric | Budget |
|---|---|
| Total desktop frames | ≤ 12 MB |
| Total mobile frames | ≤ 2 MB |
| LCP without frames | < 1.8 s |
| JS bundle | < 25 KB uncompressed |
| Lighthouse Performance (mobile) | ≥ 85 |
| CLS | < 0.05 |

Rules: `loading="lazy"` + `decoding="async"` on every `<img>`, explicit `width`/`height`
attributes to prevent layout shift, `font-display: swap`, no webfont files over 40 KB each.

---

## Accessibility

- Every interactive element focusable with a visible `:focus-visible` ring in `--accent`.
- Contrast ≥ 4.5:1 for body text against `--ink`.
- `<h1>` exactly once. Heading order never skips a level.
- Form inputs have real `<label>` elements, not placeholders standing in for labels.
- The canvas has `aria-hidden="true"` and a text alternative describing what it shows.

---

## Copy rules

- Positioning line: **"I fix and build websites for Australian small businesses."** — not
  "digital solutions", not "helping brands grow".
- The About section may state he is based in Pakistan and name the timezone benefit
  (works while Australia sleeps). Do not hide it, do not lead with it.
- Every claim must be checkable. If a metric is unknown, write the qualitative outcome instead.
- No testimonials until there are real ones. Leave the section out entirely rather than fake it.

---

## What to do when asked to build a section

1. Write the HTML with semantic elements, no wrapper divs for styling alone.
2. Add styles to `assets/styles.css` using the tokens above. Never inline styles.
3. Add behaviour to `assets/main.js` only if the section needs it.
4. State which files you changed and why, in one line each.
5. Do not touch files outside the section requested.
